A 31-year-old woman reports experiencing abdominal pain and describes a mild "tummy ache"
persisting for about a week. Upon further questioning, she reveals struggling with daily activities for the
past month. She feels sad most days, lacks motivation, and has difficulty concentrating on her work.
She often feels unable to get out of bed, sometimes sleeping for 10-12 hours, which she attributes to a
heavy sensation in her legs. She has also noticed an increase in her appetite recently. Which of the
following is most likely another feature of this patient’s condition? Answer Choices: (A) Feelings of
grandiosity and decreased need for sleep (B) An increased frequency of symptoms during winter (C)
Avoiding social activities due to fear of rejection (D) Persistent thoughts about maintaining cleanliness
(E) Intrusive thoughts about past traumatic events (F) Periods of intense anger followed by remorse (G)
Excessive worry about multiple life circumstances (H) Guilt related to the way she treats others (I)
Difficulty maintaining relationships due to unstable self-image (J) Recurrent episodes of panic with
autonomic symptoms
 A. Avoiding social activities due to fear of rejection
B. Guilt related to the way she treats others
C. An increased frequency of symptoms during winter
D. Recurrent episodes of panic with autonomic symptoms
E. Feelings of grandiosity and decreased need for sleep
F. Periods of intense anger followed by remorse
G. Persistent thoughts about maintaining cleanliness
H. Intrusive thoughts about past traumatic events
I. Difficulty maintaining relationships due to unstable self-image
J. Excessive worry about multiple life circumstances
